description.narrative: The Project Development Objective is to provide short-term employment and access to selected basic services to the most vulnerable;preserve existing implementation capacity of service delivery programs; and provide emergency cash transfers to the poor and vulnerable in response to the food crisis.

The development objective of the Emergency Crisis Response Project for Yemen is to provide short-term employment and access to selected basic services to the most vulnerable; and preserve implementation capacity of two service delivery programs. There are two components to the project, the first component being labor intensive works and community services. The overall objectives of the component are to: (a) provide income support to targeted communities through temporary employment opportunities, (b) increase the productive assets and means of livelihood of beneficiary households and communities and improve access to community and social services, and (c) preserve the implementation capacity of the SFD and PWP, as key national service delivery programs. This component includes three sub-components: cash-for-work and Youth-targeted community services; small community infrastructure; and SME revitalization and employment generation. Finally, the second component is the project management and monitoring. This component will support project management and monitoring and evaluation (M&E) to ensure that the project is successfully and efficiently implemented in conformity with the Project Appraisal Document and the Disbursement Agreement. The component will finance: (a) the UNDP's general management support (indirect) costs; (b) direct project management and supervision costs required to support implementation of the project; (c) hiring of a third-party monitoring (TPM) agency; and (d) project evaluation.

title.narrative: The number of direct beneficiaries of wage employment (core indicator: # of beneficiaries of safety net programs)

comment.narrative: <p>Target indicator partially achieved reaching 450,257 beneficiaries against the revised target of 470,700 (96 percent achievement).</p>
<p>The target was exceeded creating 10.11 million working days against a revised target of 9.365 million days (108 percent achievement). </p>

title.narrative: Area of agriculture land and terraces rehabilitated (Subcomponent 1.1)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 10,590 hectares of agricultural land rehabilitated under sub-component 1.1 against a revised target of 3,530 (300 percent achievement).</p>
<p>The target was exceeded with 13,326 hectares of agricultural land protected under sub-component 1.2 against a target of 7,000 (190 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Indirect beneficiaries from the income support (family members of the workers) (Subcomponent 1.1)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 1.98 million indirect beneficiaries of income support under sub-component 1.1 against a target of 1.15 beneficiaries (172 percent achievement). </p>
<p>The target was exceeded with 2.09 million working days created under sub-component 1.2 against a revised target of 2 million (104.5 percent achievement).</p>
<p>The target was exceeded with 2,552 classrooms rehabilitated under sub-component 1.2 against a revised target of 820 (311 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Cubic meters of water schemes constructed/rehabilitated (Subcomponent 1.2)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 362,423 cubic meters of water schemes constructed and/or rehabilitated under sub-component 1.2 against a revised target of 200,000 (181 percent achievement).</p>
<p>The target was exceeded with 397 km of road improved under sub-component 1.1 against a revised target of 290 (137 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Number of micro-finance institutions that benefited from the project (Subcomponent 1.3)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was partially achieved with five MFIs supported under sub-component 1.3 against a revised target of nine (however, the actual target was six and erroneously included as nine under the AF and AF4). Thus, the achievement of this indicator is 83 percent).</p>

title.narrative: Cubic meters of water schemes constructed /rehabilitated (Subcomponent 1.1)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 536,207 cubic meters of water schemes constructed and/or rehabilitated under subcomponent 1.1 against a revised target of 402,000 (133 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: The number of people provided with access to key services

comment.narrative: <p>Target indicator exceeded with 5.63 million people provided with short-term employment and access to selected basic services against a revised target of 2.76 million people (204 percent achievement).</p>
<p>The target was partially achieved with 5,804 microfinance clients supported under sub-component 1.3 against a revised target of 6,000 (97 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Number of individuals who benefited from farm, fishery and animal production-based wage employment (short or long term, including informal) (Subcomponent 1.3)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 63,332 individuals benefitting from farm, fishery and animal production-based wage employment under sub-component 1.3 against a revised target of 46,100 (137 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Number of people (women and children) who benefitted from the nutrition services (total)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 678,723 women and children benefitting from nutrition services against a revised target of 216,191 women and children (314 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Indirect beneficiaries from the income support (family members of the workers) (Subcomponent 1.2)

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 838,149 indirect beneficiaries from income support against a revised target of 700,000 (120 percent achievement). </p>

title.narrative: Percent of surveyed beneficiaries who expressed satisfaction with the project participatory approach

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded with 90 percent of surveyed beneficiaries expressing satisfaction with the project participatory approach against a target of 75 percent (120 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Percentage of registered grievances that are addressed within the timeframe specified in the project implementation manual

comment.narrative: <p>The target was achieved with 91 percent of registered grievances addressed within the specified timeframe against a target of 90 percent (101 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: The percentage of core staff positions

comment.narrative: <p>This indicator exceeded its target with 103 percent core staff positions at SFD and PWP maintained against a revised target of 100 percent (103 percent achievement).</p>

<p>The target was partially achieved reaching 1.45 million beneficiary households on average (through 11 payment cycles) against a target of 1.5 million beneficiary households (97 percent achievement). </p>

title.narrative: Beneficiaries of social safety net programs

comment.narrative: <p>The target was exceeded reaching an average 9.1 million individuals with emergency cash transfers against a target of 8 million individuals (113 percent achievement).</p>

title.narrative: Number of surveyed beneficiaries who report receiving full amount of benefit

comment.narrative: <p>The target was achieved with 99.87 of surveyed beneficiaries reporting having received the full benefit amount under Component 3, against a target of 100 percent  (99 percent achievement).</p>
